name: District of Saanich
note: lək̓ʷəŋən (Songhees, Esquimalt) and W̱SÁNEĆ (Tsartlip, Pauquachin, Tsawout, Tseycum, Malahat) peoples.
statement: We acknowledge that the District of Saanich lies within the territories of the lək ̓ ʷəŋən peoples represented by the Songhees and Esquimalt Nations and the W̱ SÁNEĆ peoples represented by the W̱ JOȽEȽP (Tsartlip), BOḰEĆEN (Pauquachin), SȾÁUTW̱ (Tsawout), W̱ SIḴEM (Tseycum) and MÁLEXEȽ (Malahat) Nations.
